reviewer: Primary implementation agent, exploratory text review, not independent human evaluation
masking: Texts were initially read under shuffled labels. Initial triage was unmasked and numeric scores were recorded after decoding; this is NOT a preregistered independent blind comparison.
scale: 0 absent/contradictory; 1 generic; 2 partly concrete; 3 clear; 4 clear and economical
null_meaning: not applicable or hard-excluded; never converted to zero or imputed
policy: Hard failures receive no creative score. Controls receive no emotion score. No composite or population improvement estimate.
